releaseNotes:
Release v0.14.0

New Features:
- Deploy Solutions - deploy all executable graphs of a solution at once (PS-201)
- Text in Image node - draw anchored text onto images, with 0-1 opacity slider (PS-202)
- Preview Image node - in-graph image thumbnails (PS-203)

Improvements:
- New Godot bridge

Bug Fixes:
- Embed Common-Controls v6 manifest in the Windows backend executable (PS-196)
